conversationId.description: Identifier of the conversation this turn belongs to. Rows from the same conversation share the same `conversationId`. Use it as the `threadId` for the Get assistant conversation thread endpoint.

queryCategory.description: Auto-assigned category grouping for the conversation, if applicable.

resolutionStatus.description: Whether the assistant successfully answered this turn. Computed per row: `unanswered` when the assistant marked the question as not covered by the available documentation. If the conversation is recorded as unanswered, for example because a response failed, and no turn was marked as not covered, every turn in the conversation is `unanswered`. Otherwise `answered`.

response.description: The assistant's response. For clarifying-question turns, this is the question the assistant asked the user.

responseType.description: Type of response returned to the user. `answer` is a final answer. `clarifying_question` means the assistant asked the user a follow-up question instead of answering. Defaults to `answer` when not present.

sources.description: Documentation pages referenced in the response.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the user message that started this turn.
